title: Fix pytest CI API dependency installation
intent: Restore the Pytest workflow's ability to import the FastAPI app and keep the committed OpenAPI snapshot stable during CI.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: No application logic or test assertions changed.

what_changed: Updated the Pytest workflow to install the api extra alongside dev dependencies before OpenAPI freshness checks and pytest.
Pinned the FastAPI dependency below 0.128.0 and added httpx to the api extra so the committed OpenAPI snapshot stays fresh and FastAPI TestClient imports cleanly in CI.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without these dependency updates the workflow fails before tests with a missing FastAPI import, and newer FastAPI/Starlette combinations also drift the generated OpenAPI snapshot and require httpx for TestClient-based tests.

commands_run: source /tmp/code-audit-ci-fix/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -e '.[dev,api]'
test_results: OpenAPI snapshot freshness check passed in a fresh environment with dev+api extras installed.
Targeted FastAPI endpoint and OpenAPI snapshot validation tests passed.
verification.notes: Also reproduced the original failure in a separate fresh environment with only the dev extra installed: refresh_openapi_snapshot.py exited with "No module named 'fastapi'".
